alternatives: Single global right panel shared across sessions
Right panel as modal overlay only
choice: Left sidebar is global (projects > sessions); right sidebar is per-session scoped (browser, files, GitHub tabs follow the active session); center column owns conversation plus customizable input bar with follow-ups and mode toggles.
rationale: Base prompt names left project/session sidebar and right per-session sidebar with the three views; scoping the right panel per session preserves context when switching sessions.
Fixing the contract now prevents Directions from collapsing the workbench into a single-column chatbot.
risks: Three-pane density is hard at 375px; responsive strategy must collapse sidebars into drawers without losing scope semantics.
revisitWhen: Usability evidence shows session-switching confusion attributable to scoping.
